request: Ward adds a health buffer instead of a poise buffer: when Ward is added, it adds the points to the health bar and must hit the health bar first before hitting health. Order: Block > Ward > Poise + Health.
success: Playing Mote Shield (Ward 1, Barrier 1) renders the blue Ward health-buffer segment (.m-ward-seg) and +5 readout (.m-ward-bonus) on the player's HP bar alongside purple Bonus Poise (+5) on the Poise bar, with zero console errors and no viewport overflow at 1280x800 and 390x844.
failure: No blue Ward segment or +5 readout appears on the HP bar after Mote Shield; Ward status is missing; console errors or layout overflow occur.

success.label: The player holds a Ward status
Blue Ward health-buffer segment is present on the player HP bar
Player HP bar displays +5 Ward bonus
Player Poise bar displays +5 Bonus Poise from Barrier only
Player HP bar stays inside the combat screen
The hand stays inside the combat screen

failure.label: No Ward segment on player HP bar
